description: The demo question set of C18 §11.1 over the organisation graph that the UI's mock server loads (testsuite/ask/org.ttl, from ui/mock/data.mjs). Answerable questions have a gold query; clarify and unanswerable questions score the clarification and the refusal. complexity is the score of §5.5 for the gold query.

questions.question: How many people are in the dataset?
questions.gold: SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?p) AS ?n) WHERE { ?p a ?cls . ?cls rdfs:subClassOf* ex:Person . }

questions.question: Which teams are there?
List the companies and the year each was founded.
In which city is Tessellate based?
What is Ada Lovelace's email address?
How old is Grace Hopper?
Which skills does Alan Turing have?
Which projects does Barbara Liskov contribute to?
Which team does Edsger Dijkstra belong to?
Which company does Margaret Hamilton work for?
What is the country code of Kyoto?
Which universities are there, and where is each based?
What is the description of the Delta Merge project?
Is Linus Torvalds a manager?
Who works for a company based in Berlin?
Which people are members of the Storage team?
Which company is the Query Engine team part of?
Who knows Ada Lovelace?
Which people based in Lisbon have the Rust skill?
questions.gold: SELECT ?p WHERE { ?p ex:basedIn res:Lisbon ; ex:hasSkill res:skill_Rust }

questions.question: Who wrote publications about SPARQL?
questions.gold: SELECT DISTINCT ?author WHERE { ?pub ex:author ?author ; ex:about ?topic . ?topic skos:prefLabel "SPARQL"@en }

questions.question: Which researchers are alumni of the Open Semantics University?
questions.gold: SELECT ?p WHERE { ?p a ex:Researcher ; ex:alumnusOf res:Open_Semantics_University }

questions.question: List the engineers with their team and the company they work for.
questions.gold: SELECT ?p ?team ?company WHERE { ?p a ex:Engineer ; ex:memberOf ?team ; ex:worksFor ?company }

questions.question: Which teams belong to Tessellate?
questions.gold: SELECT ?team WHERE { ?team a ex:Team ; ex:partOf res:Tessellate }

questions.question: Who works on the Sparkles project?
Which people are based in the same city as the company they work for?
List each publication with the names of its authors.
questions.gold: SELECT ?pub ?name WHERE { ?pub a ex:Publication ; ex:author ?a . ?a foaf:name ?name }

questions.question: How many people are in each team?
questions.gold: SELECT ?team (COUNT(?p) AS ?members) WHERE { ?p ex:memberOf ?team } GROUP BY ?team

questions.question: What is the average salary at each company?
questions.gold: SELECT ?company (AVG(?salary) AS ?average) WHERE { ?p ex:worksFor ?company ; ex:salary ?salary } GROUP BY ?company

questions.question: Which team has the most members?
questions.gold: SELECT ?team (COUNT(?p) AS ?members) WHERE { ?p ex:memberOf ?team } GROUP BY ?team ORDER BY DESC(?members) LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many publications were issued each year?
questions.gold: SELECT ?year (COUNT(?pub) AS ?n) WHERE { ?pub a ex:Publication ; dcterms:issued ?year } GROUP BY ?year

questions.question: What is the total number of citations of all publications?
Which skill do the most people have?
questions.gold: SELECT ?skill (COUNT(?p) AS ?n) WHERE { ?p ex:hasSkill ?skill } GROUP BY ?skill ORDER BY DESC(?n) LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the highest salary?
Which companies have more than 8 employees?
questions.gold: SELECT ?company (COUNT(?p) AS ?n) WHERE { ?p ex:worksFor ?company } GROUP BY ?company HAVING (COUNT(?p) > 8)

questions.question: How many people are based in each city?
questions.gold: SELECT ?city (COUNT(DISTINCT ?p) AS ?n) WHERE { ?p a ?cls . ?cls rdfs:subClassOf* ex:Person . ?p ex:basedIn ?city } GROUP BY ?city

questions.question: Who is the oldest person?
questions.gold: SELECT ?p ?age WHERE { ?p foaf:age ?age } ORDER BY DESC(?age) LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which publication has the most citations?
questions.gold: SELECT ?pub ?c WHERE { ?pub ex:citations ?c } ORDER BY DESC(?c) LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which teams have more members than the average team?
questions.gold: SELECT ?team ?n WHERE { { SELECT ?team (COUNT(?p) AS ?n) WHERE { ?p ex:memberOf ?team } GROUP BY ?team } { SELECT (AVG(?m) AS ?avg) WHERE { SELECT ?t (COUNT(?q) AS ?m) WHERE { ?q ex:memberOf ?t } GROUP BY ?t } } FILTER(?n > ?avg) }

questions.question: Which companies employ more engineers than the average company does?
questions.gold: SELECT ?company ?n WHERE { { SELECT ?company (COUNT(?p) AS ?n) WHERE { ?p a ex:Engineer ; ex:worksFor ?company } GROUP BY ?company } { SELECT (AVG(?m) AS ?avg) WHERE { SELECT ?c (COUNT(?q) AS ?m) WHERE { ?q a ex:Engineer ; ex:worksFor ?c } GROUP BY ?c } } FILTER(?n > ?avg) }

questions.question: Which managers manage a team that none of the people they know belongs to?
questions.gold: SELECT ?m ?team WHERE { ?m a ex:Manager ; ex:manages ?team FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?m foaf:knows ?k . ?k ex:memberOf ?team } }

questions.question: Which teams have no manager?
questions.gold: SELECT ?team WHERE { ?team a ex:Team FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?m ex:manages ?team } }

questions.question: Which people have not authored any publication?
questions.gold: SELECT DISTINCT ?p WHERE { ?p a ?cls . ?cls rdfs:subClassOf* ex:Person . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?pub ex:author ?p } }

questions.question: Which employees of a company do not have the SPARQL skill?
questions.gold: SELECT ?p WHERE { ?p ex:worksFor ?company MINUS { ?p ex:hasSkill res:skill_SPARQL } }

questions.question: Which cities have no company based in them?
questions.gold: SELECT ?city WHERE { ?city a ex:City FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?company a ex:Company ; ex:basedIn ?city } }

questions.question: Which people have no French comment?
questions.gold: SELECT DISTINCT ?p WHERE { ?p a ?cls . ?cls rdfs:subClassOf* ex:Person . OPTIONAL { ?p rdfs:comment ?c FILTER(LANG(?c) = "fr") } FILTER(!BOUND(?c)) }

questions.question: Which organizations is the Storage team part of, directly or indirectly?
Who are the people that Ada Lovelace's acquaintances know?
questions.gold: SELECT DISTINCT ?p WHERE { res:Ada_Lovelace foaf:knows/foaf:knows ?p FILTER(?p != res:Ada_Lovelace) }

questions.question: Which people are employees, counting managers and engineers?
Which classes are kinds of Agent?
Who knows someone who works for Quadrant Labs?
Who started after the start of 2020?
Who started most recently?
questions.gold: SELECT ?p ?d WHERE { ?p ex:startDate ?d } ORDER BY DESC(?d) LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which companies were founded before 2010?
questions.gold: SELECT ?company WHERE { ?company a ex:Company ; ex:founded ?y FILTER(xsd:integer(STR(?y)) < 2010) }

questions.question: How many people started in each year?
questions.gold: SELECT ?year (COUNT(?p) AS ?n) WHERE { ?p ex:startDate ?d BIND(YEAR(?d) AS ?year) } GROUP BY ?year

questions.question: Which publications were issued in 2020 or later?
What is the French label of the Person class?
Which people have a comment in French?
Which entity is labelled Berlin?
Which team is called the Storage team?
questions.gold: SELECT ?team WHERE { ?team a ex:Team ; rdfs:label "Storage team"@en }

questions.question: Which people are in Research?
questions.note: Research names a team (res:team_Research) and reads as the class ex:Researcher.

questions.question: Which companies are the biggest?
questions.note: Biggest by employees, by teams or by projects is not said.

questions.question: Who is connected to Tim Berners-Lee?
questions.note: Connected by foaf:knows, by team or by company is not said.

questions.question: Which people are senior?
questions.note: Seniority by age, by start date or by the Manager class is not said.

questions.question: What is Ada Lovelace's phone number?
questions.note: The data holds no phone numbers.

questions.question: What is the revenue of Tessellate?
Which people are married?
questions.note: The data holds no marital status.

questions.question: When was the Storage team created?
Who is the CEO of Lattice & Co?
questions.note: The data names no CEO or role in a company.
